heading: Sunset
lead: The authority given to the Secretary under this subchapter shall expire 9 years after the date of the enactment of this subchapter.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: The date of the enactment of this subchapter, referred to in text, is the date of enactment of Pub. L. 114–289, which was approved Dec. 16, 2016.

sourceCredit: (Added Pub. L. 114–289, title VII, § 701, Dec. 16, 2016, 130 Stat. 1494; amended Pub. L. 117–328, div. G, title I, § 123, Dec. 29, 2022, 136 Stat. 4789.)
